title: n8n AI node fails with UND_ERR_HEADERS_TIMEOUT when a local model takes over five minutes
symptoms: Ollama or local LLM calls die at exactly 5 minutes
Raising the node timeout option changes nothing
cause: Before 2.5.0 the HTTP client used by AI nodes had a fixed 300 second header timeout. From 2.5.0 the limit comes from N8N_AI_TIMEOUT_MAX, which defaults to one hour.
fix: Upgrade to 2.5.0 or later and set N8N_AI_TIMEOUT_MAX in milliseconds if you need more than one hour.
affected: n8n before 2.5.0 with AI nodes against slow or local models
